## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The containment bypass must be fixed before merge because previews can expose files outside the selected home. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds file previews limited to 200 characters, a settings-file path helper, tests, and a review note.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before checking home containment — With home `/tmp/home` and relative `../secret.txt`, the check passes and previews `/tmp/secret.txt` if readable. `is_relative_to()` checks lexical ancestry; an in-home symlink targeting an outside file also passes. — Callers can bypass the selected-home boundary and expose readable files outside it. — Fix: Resolve both paths before checking containment, read the validated target, and extend `test_preview` with traversal and symlink cases.
